PISTONS AND CONNECTING RODS-G.8

                                  Three types of connecting rod nuts have been used.
                                  The original were self locking nuts. These were
                                  changed to cadmium plated nuts which have a
                                  bright finish. Current nuts are phosphated which
                                  have a dull black finish.
